scope: Full original clean test PNGs -> installed Windows OCR -> fixed text/word-box rules. No DOM, target crops, source values, candidate/ground-truth regions or class hints enter prediction. Rules written after public release; not blind/pre-registered. No trained detector, tuning, model download, provider API, training or credits. Existing OS OCR inference is performed locally.

environment.source: full original PNG frames; no ground-truth crops or DOM text passed to OCR
environment.network: No network client or external service is called by this script; OS internals were not instrumented.

literal.definition: Class-aware score-ordered IoU >= 0.5 matching at the submitted confidence cutoff; not mAP. Pixel coverage is necessary for redaction and distinct from IoU recall.

contrastive_pairs.rule: All focal sensitive fragments matched in sensitive arm AND no prediction covers >=25% of any focal benign candidate fragment in control arm.
